info.name: AssistantPlatform — Labs 0-5 full flow
info.description:
End-to-end tests for the clinic virtual secretary.
Run Clinic.Api, Channel.Gateway and Agent.Worker first. Run folders in order.
Each Send → wait 15–30 s → Read. Check the Postman Console (View → Show Postman Console) for the printed last reply.

item.name: 6 — Worker diagnostics (Agent.Worker :5300)

request.description: Lists every diagnostics endpoint and the log files.
Redis, Postgres, RabbitMQ, Clinic.Api, Qdrant, LLM in one call. 503 = at least one check failed: read checks[].error and .hint.

exec: const r = pm.response.json(); (r.checks||[]).filter(c=>!c.ok).forEach(c => console.log('FAIL', c.name, c.error, '→', c.hint));

request.description: End-to-end through RabbitMQ. Uses a TEST phone (its conversation/pending/upcoming appointments are reset). Each step shows project, queue, timing; failures show the log to open. Takes 1-4 min on CPU.

exec: r.steps.forEach(s => console.log(`${s.no}. ${s.status.padEnd(7)} ${s.ms} ms  ${s.step}  [${s.project}] queue=${s.queue}` + (s.error ? `\n   ERROR ${s.error}\n   LOOK AT ${s.lookAt}` : '')));
